title: Recitation check: Al-A'la and At-Tariq 1 to 8, and the laam review: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-A'la, At-Tariq 1 to 8 and waqf
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recitation check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 30. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: the letter ل; its rules decide if it is said, merged, heavy or light
the Name Allah: its laam is heavy after fathah or dammah, light after kasrah
stopping at the end of a word to take a breath

questions.q: Recite Al-A'la 87:1 to 8 together with the heavy laam in 87:7.
Recitation check: today's group recites Al-A'la and At-Tariq 86:1 to 8 to the teacher. Everyone else completes the laam check on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Rubric marked; laam check answers on the teacher sheet.

questions.q: Extend: write your target for next half term.
questions.a: For example: 'I will stop on a sukoon at every ayah end.'
A) heavy. After the fathah of هُوَ, the laam of Allah is heavy.

questions.q: Think again: This half term we learned to stop well and say the laam correctly. Which change has made your recitation better?
questions.a: Answers vary: perhaps stopping on a sukoon, or the heavy and light laam of Allah.
